events.title: New Heroes, New Features, and a New Boss
events.summary: Hello, Lords!Thank you so much for your continued support and interest in Legend of Defenders. We’re thrilled to announce that the Demo is now live!This update brings a ton of new content—we’ve added several new characters and officially opened the Black Market. Unfortunately, due to major data structure changes in this version, Playtest save data cannot be carried over directly to the Demo. This means you’ll need to start your castle defense journey again. events.title: The Blacksmith Is Now Open!
events.summary: Greetings, Castle Lords!Thank you so much for supporting Legend of Defenders and for sharing your feedback and suggestions with us!In the latest Playtest, we’ve added the long-awaited Blacksmith system! You can now enhance and enchant your equipment, as well as reforge its substats, giving you even more ways to strengthen your heroes and defenses.We attach great importance to your gaming experience, and we will continue to closely monitor, actively respond to, and optimize based on your feedback
